title: Muse Calm Score vs Sleep Efficiency Correlation
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=muse:session
join type=left _time [search index=personal sourcetype=emfit:sleep
fields _time sleep_efficiency_pct]
where calm_score<40 AND sleep_efficiency_pct<80
description: Relates low Muse calm scores to nights with poor Emfit sleep efficiency.
value: Surfacing muse calm score vs sleep efficiency correlation helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant health, sleep & wearables export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out when muse calm score vs sleep efficiency correlation matters for your routine.
